rationale: Retains frame-driven directional control for the credited first level, but replaces the single-rope assumption with colour-specific ball, endpoint-pair and target identification. Later frames show multiple ropes, so endpoint pairs are inferred from each ball's midpoint and surrounding colour. Targets and models refresh on level transitions. Donor-style observed edges, state visits and failed-action penalties guide exploration; observed endpoint displacement calibrates directional effects. Receding-horizon planning routes both endpoints and their ball around walls and hazard regions, and switches to unfinished ropes.
